items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I just say my boy Danny worked with Kev

ctx.x: Fireed him out my band, yeah.

He went with Joe Rose, so he was going to play a right, you understand that? Yeah. I just say my boy Danny worked with Kev, he must have carried the instruments himself. He's got to get all that, he's tuned up, got the artificial tuning on, if you understand what I mean. Of course I can play it, but I meant to say he's a nice brother and everything like that, but you see that kind of fellas like that used to play house parties around you, you know like somebody did a fish ride or piano band or something like…
Who were the musicians that you really enjoyed playing and you think were really good?
